concepts.definition: a resource controlled by a business from which future economic benefits are expected
a present obligation of a business arising from past events and expected to require an outflow of resources
the owner's financial interest in a business after liabilities are deducted from assets
income earned from the ordinary activities of a business before related expenses are deducted
a cost consumed or incurred in the process of earning revenue during an accounting period
the left-hand side of a ledger account used according to double-entry accounting rules
the right-hand side of a ledger account used according to double-entry accounting rules
the principal book or record containing individual accounts to which transactions are posted
a list of ledger account balances prepared to test whether total debits equal total credits
a financial statement showing a business's assets, liabilities, and equity at a specified date
